newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Crossair postpones flights to Sarajevo.
newsitem.headline: Crossair postpones flights to Sarajevo.

text.p: Crossair AG, the regional airline of the Swissair AG group, on Thursday said it had postponed the start of its scheduled service to Sarajevo due to the airport's inadequate navigation systems, snow removal and de-icing equipment.

Crossair, which had hoped to start scheduled services to Sarajevo from Zurich on December 13, said a final test flight this week had shown that the infrastructure at the airport was not yet up to standards that would allow Crossair to guarantee a reliable and on-time service.
Crossair however expects to start scheduled flight to Sarajevo early next year when the airport has upgraded the equipment.
